entities.name: Kiki-Jiki
entities.description: An akki of Sokenzan on Kamigawa who could duplicate creatures with illusionism.

entities.name: Paku-Paku
entities.description: The akki tribe elder who drove Kiki-Jiki out.

entities.name: Keiga
entities.description: A dragon who took a liking to Kiki-Jiki, tasked him with stealing her pearl and trained him.

entities.name: Meloku
entities.description: Soratami ambassador whom Kiki-Jiki was sent to rob of Keiga's pearl.

entities.name: Kiki-Jiki's Reflection
entities.description: The reflection that escaped from a shattered soratami mirror and split from Kiki-Jiki.

entities.name: Oboro
entities.description: Soratami realm Keiga flew Kiki-Jiki to.

events.summary: Paku-Paku drives Kiki-Jiki from the tribe.
events.quote: Paku-Paku drove Kiki-Jiki from the tribe.

events.summary: Kiki-Jiki falls into Keiga's lair; the dragon recognizes his magical potential.
events.quote: The dragon took a liking to Kiki-Jiki and recognized his magical potential.

events.summary: Kiki-Jiki shatters an enchanted mirror and his reflection escapes; the two split up.
events.quote: Kiki-Jiki shattered the mirror, and his reflection escaped.

events.summary: Kiki-Jiki escapes and trains with Keiga, becoming a great duplication sorcerer.
events.quote: after training with Keiga he began to hone his magical talent

relations.quote: after training with Keiga he began to hone his magical talent

relations.note: Paku-Paku grew fed up and banished him.
relations.quote: Paku-Paku drove Kiki-Jiki from the tribe.
